title: Weather Urban Downscaling: Recurrent and State-Space Architectures for Urban Air-Temperature Downscaling
description: Code companion for benchmarking U-Net, ConvLSTM, Transformer, and Mamba-based architectures for hourly 100-m urban air-temperature downscaling over the Barcelona Metropolitan Area.
